name: Kinetic Sport
tagline: Big numbers, hard edges, always moving.
description: A dark-first system that feels like a race clock. Condensed uppercase headlines at huge sizes, giant tabular numerals, an acid lime that marks what is live or leading, skewed labels, and diagonal stripes used like track markings.

fonts.role: display headlines and big numerals, uppercase
body, labels, tables with tabular numerals

palette.role: acid lime: live, leading, primary action fills; never text on light backgrounds

allowedGradients.reason: diagonal track-marking stripe texture on decorative bands and empty areas only

do: Set headlines in Big Shoulders Display uppercase with tight tracking at the largest step the layout allows
Make the key number on every screen giant and tabular
Use a -12deg skew on small labels and badges, with the text itself counter-skewed back upright
Mark what is live or leading with the lime fill, and keep lime off light backgrounds as text
Use the stripe utility only on decorative bands, never behind text
dont: Do not use shadows or glows
Do not use lime as text on light backgrounds
Do not use more than lime and hot as accents
Do not write cheesy motivational slogans

components.name: Button
components.notes: Primary is a lime block with uppercase condensed label in ink; secondary is an ink outline; ghost is an uppercase text link with an arrow. Hover nudges the label 2px right.

components.name: Input
components.notes: Surface field with an edge border, uppercase Barlow label, bib or time formats in tabular numerals. Error uses hot.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Category select with a chevron, uppercase options.

components.name: Checkbox and toggle
components.notes: Square checkbox that fills lime with an ink check. Switch is a hard-edged track with a square knob that turns lime when on.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Skewed labels: LIVE in hot, LEADER in lime, category in outline, DNF in hot outline.

components.name: Card
components.notes: Personal result: giant finish time, position out of field, pace per km, a stripe band on top.

components.name: Navbar
components.notes: Condensed uppercase wordmark, links, a lime register action. Mobile menu is a details disclosure with large uppercase rows.

components.name: Modal and sheet
components.notes: Hard-edged sheet with a lime top bar, uppercase title, two actions.

components.name: Table
components.notes: Leaderboard with rank, bib, name, category, two splits and finish, tabular numerals, the leader row marked with a lime rank cell.

components.name: Bento grid
components.notes: 2x2 giant finish time, a pace bar chart, field size stat, weather and course tile, a stripe band tile.

components.name: Empty state
components.notes: A stripe band, "No results yet" in condensed uppercase, one line, one action.

components.name: Toast
components.notes: Hard-edged bar with a skewed label and tabular time.
